CONTROL YOUR WORKSPACE

Settings.

Connect your capture backend. Keep model credentials on the server.

Capture and analysis backend

The self-hosted backend runs Chromium and calls OpenAI. This hosted interface can organise screenshots independently.

Leave blank when using the app from its own backend. Hosted pages need an HTTPS backend.

Kept in memory for this session. Never enter an OpenAI API key here.

Where your data lives

Uploaded screenshots, crops and research notes are stored in this browser using IndexedDB. Capture jobs and AI response cache are stored by your backend. Clearing this browser’s site data removes the local collection. CSV exports contain metadata, not image backups.

Analysis cost

The backend limits the number of new analysis requests per day. It does not enforce a currency budget. Set a provider-side spending limit as well. Capture-only use needs no OpenAI key.

CREATIVE DETAILS

Ad evidence

Performance and campaign targeting are unavailable.

Research with evidence

Input a public page URL or a screenshot. Review actual ad regions. Then inspect visible copy, offers, calls to action and interpreted creative patterns.

Useful for creative strategists, agency researchers and marketers preparing briefs. A captured ad is evidence of a sampled visit, not proof that a campaign is winning.

The source supports self-hosting. Browser capture may be blocked or incomplete on some websites. Screenshot uploads provide an alternative.
